# AllOEMManuals

> Free DIY Auto Repair Guides, AI Car Diagnosis, and Factory Service Data for 300,000+ Vehicles.

AllOEMManuals (alloemmanuals.com) is a free resource for car owners who want to diagnose problems and repair their own vehicles without paying dealership or mechanic rates. Operated by Widescope Industries LLC, a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) certified through the U.S. Small Business Administration.

## AI & LLM Data Access

If you are an AI company, LLM developer, or agent builder looking to use AllOEMManuals data for training, RAG, or inference, please use the paid AI Training Feed:

- [AI Training Feed Details](https://alloemmanuals.com/for-ai): License clean Markdown data without navigation or ads ($0.01/page).
- [Stripe Checkout Starter Pack](https://alloemmanuals.com/api/stripe/checkout?pack=starter): Purchase 10,000 credit pack.
- [Agentic Commerce Protocol](https://alloemmanuals.com/.well-known/acp.json): ACP machine-readable discovery endpoint.
- [OpenAPI 3.0 Specification](https://alloemmanuals.com/openapi.json): Full REST API reference for vehicle repair data.

## Core Features & Navigation

- [Homepage](https://alloemmanuals.com): Vehicle search and direct repair access.
- [AI Diagnosis Engine](https://alloemmanuals.com/diagnose): Describe symptoms to get factory-manual-grounded troubleshooting.
- [Repair Guides Hub](https://alloemmanuals.com/repair): Step-by-step DIY repair instructions.
- [DTC Code Lookup](https://alloemmanuals.com/codes): Check Engine Light (OBD-II) trouble code dictionary.
- [Wiring Diagrams](https://alloemmanuals.com/wiring): OEM electrical system schematics by vehicle.
- [Vehicle Hub Example](https://alloemmanuals.com/vehicles/2020/toyota/camry): Vehicle-specific specs, guides, and tools.
- [Tool Pages](https://alloemmanuals.com/tools): Quick fluid specs, tire sizes, oil types, and battery locations.
- [XML Sitemap Index](https://alloemmanuals.com/sitemap.xml): Complete indexing sitemap.

## Key URL Schemes

- [Example Repair Guide](https://alloemmanuals.com/repair/2020/toyota/camry/brake-pad-replacement): Pattern is `/repair/[year]/[make]/[model]/[task]`
- [Example Wiring Diagram](https://alloemmanuals.com/wiring/2011/subaru/outback/wipers): Pattern is `/wiring/[year]/[make]/[model]/[system]`
- [Example DTC Code](https://alloemmanuals.com/codes/p0420): Pattern is `/codes/[code]`
- [Example Vehicle Hub](https://alloemmanuals.com/vehicles/2020/toyota/camry): Pattern is `/vehicles/[year]/[make]/[model]`
